hints.seatPrefix: One or two letters, e.g. A
hints.stops: One stop per line: name, minutes from origin, km from origin
hints.password: At least 8 characters, with one letter and one number.

validation.phone: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number (e.g. 01712345678)
validation.email: Please enter a valid email address
validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters
validation.passwordLetter: Password must contain at least one letter
validation.passwordNumber: Password must contain at least one number

messages.createdWithLogin: Driver added with a portal login
messages.failed: Could not save. Please check the form and try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Fleet, schedules and staff at a glance.
dashboard.chartEmpty: No data yet — schedule a trip to see it here.
dashboard.revenueNote: Revenue and bookings now come from the Phase 8 reports page, which reads stored bookings and refunds.

buses.title: Buses
buses.subtitle: The fleet, its seat layout and availability.
buses.formHint: Total seats are calculated from rows × seats per row, minus disabled seats.
buses.empty: No buses yet. Add the first one.
buses.deleteBody: This removes the bus permanently. A bus that already has trips cannot be deleted — set it to inactive instead.
buses.seatsPreview: {{seats}} seats will be sold on this bus

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.subtitle: Drivers, their licence and assigned bus.
drivers.formHint: A driver profile can exist without a login. Create the portal login when the driver is ready.
drivers.empty: No drivers yet. Add the first one.
drivers.deleteBody: This deletes {{name}} and any linked login. A driver with trips cannot be deleted — set the status to inactive instead.
drivers.loginHint: Optional. The driver uses this email and password to sign in to the driver dashboard.
drivers.createLogin: Create a login for this driver

routes.title: Routes
routes.subtitle: Origin, destination and stops for every service.
routes.formHint: Stops are optional. They power the seat map, boarding points and trip progress later.
routes.empty: No routes yet. Add the first one.
routes.deleteBody: This removes the route permanently. A route used by a trip cannot be deleted — set it to inactive instead.

trips.title: Trips
trips.subtitle: Scheduled departures for every route.
trips.formHint: A bus or driver cannot be on two live trips at the same departure time.
trips.empty: No trips yet. Schedule the first one.
trips.cancelBody: The trip stays in the records as cancelled and its bus and driver slot is freed, so a replacement trip can be scheduled.

counters.title: Counters
counters.subtitle: Ticket counters and their staff.
counters.formHint: Counters sell tickets and take cash at the terminal.
counters.empty: No counters yet. Add the first one.
counters.deleteBody: This removes the counter permanently. Reassign its staff first — a counter with staff cannot be deleted.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Staff accounts. Passengers create their own accounts.
users.selfHint: You cannot change your own role or status — ask another administrator.
users.formHint: Choose Admin for full access, or Counter staff and assign a counter.
users.roleBody: Changing a role signs this person out of their current session.
users.statusBody: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in while suspended. You can restore the account at any time.

settings.title: System settings
settings.subtitle: Cancellation policy, booking limits, notifications and ticket text.
settings.cancellationHint: The full-refund window must be longer than the partial-refund window.
settings.holdMinutesHint: How long a selected seat is reserved before payment.
settings.selfCancel: Passengers can cancel their own bookings
settings.notificationsHint: Mock mode only logs messages. Email and SMS need provider credentials.
settings.mockModeHint: Log messages instead of sending them.
settings.paymentsHint: Online payment needs SSLCommerz credentials in the server environment.
settings.ticketHint: Printed on every ticket, in both languages.
settings.policyOrderError: Must be longer than the partial-refund window

cancellations.title: Cancellations and refunds
cancellations.subtitle: Cancelled tickets and the refund recorded by the policy.
cancellations.manualRefundNote: Refunds are returned outside the system (cash at the counter, bank or bKash). Marking one processed records that it happened — no gateway refund is sent automatically.
cancellations.rejectBody: The cancellation for {{code}} stays recorded, but the refund will show as rejected. The ticket keeps its paid status.

reports.title: Sales reports
reports.subtitle: Tickets, money collected, refunds and route performance, built from stored records.
reports.dailyHint: Collected money for tickets booked on each day (Dhaka time).
reports.mixHint: Tickets by channel and payment method.
reports.refundsHint: Pending and approved amounts are not subtracted from net until processed.
reports.generatedAt: Generated {{time}}. All reports are read-only snapshots of stored data.
